## How to compare models and variants

Verify model year, trim, engine or battery, transmission, safety equipment, homologated mileage or range, independent crash-test results and service coverage.

## Price and running costs

Check local ex-showroom or MSRP pricing separately from registration, taxes, insurance, fuel or charging, maintenance and financing. No live price is implied.

## Buyer checklist

Request an official variant brochure, test drive, compare total ownership cost, inspect warranty terms and confirm delivery estimates.

## Verification and limitations

This profile is based on a source directory record. An empty field means the information was not verified, not that a feature or course is unavailable. Figures and specifications may change by country, variant and date. Always confirm on the [source page](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Buick_GL8) before applying or buying. Published as a reference guide on 2026-11-07, not as breaking news.

## जरूरी जाँच

स्थानीय एक्स-शोरूम कीमत के साथ रजिस्ट्रेशन, टैक्स, बीमा, ईंधन या चार्जिंग, रखरखाव और फाइनेंस का खर्च अलग से जाँचें। यहाँ लाइव कीमत का दावा नहीं है।

आधिकारिक वेरिएंट ब्रोशर माँगें, टेस्ट ड्राइव लें और कुल खर्च की तुलना करें। वारंटी की शर्तें और डिलीवरी का समय जाँचें।
